## Print-quality notes

- **brochure-trifold** — Source has FOUR 99 mm panels (396 mm) on an A4-landscape page (297 mm). Chrome shrinks the sheet to ~75 % to fit, so type prints smaller than designed. A tri-fold is 3 panels per side, 2 sides — needs a source decision (drop a panel, or 2 pages). Delivered as rendered.
- **business-card** — FIXED IN SOURCE (A-027): three 90 mm cards side by side exceeded A4's printable width and the left card was clipped. Cards now stack; one page, nothing clipped.
- **deck-pitch** — FIXED IN SOURCE (A-027): invalid `@page … landscape` (printed Letter portrait) and screen-only body padding / slide margin (blank pages 2 and 10). Now 8 pages at 254×143 mm.
- **form-feedback** — 2 pages (~17 % over one A4); break falls before section 4. Acceptable as a 2-page form.
- **handout-a5-government** — Content overruns A5 by ~8 %; footer spills to page 2. Trim spacing. Delivered as rendered.
- **handout-a5-mediator** — Content overruns A5 by ~3 %; PDF has a blank page 2. Trim spacing or the AI-labelling note. Delivered as rendered.
- **sheet-observation** — Runs to 2 pages (~10 % over one A4). Acceptable as a 2-page sheet; the break falls mid-section — consider a forced break before section H.

All 13 PDFs match their declared `@page` size to within 0.3 mm. Every file loaded both web fonts before rendering (checked via `document.fonts`). `print-color-adjust: exact` is honoured — backgrounds print.

**Content placeholders (not export defects):** every piece carries a `QR CODE` placeholder box; the deck and business cards carry `[Founder Name]` / `[Team Member Name]` / `[+91 XXXXX XXXXX]` placeholders; the deck's market figures (63M+ MSMEs, ₹32L Cr, 1.5M+ cases) are unsourced in the file — cross-check against the red-team caveats before external use.
